name: XrmFrameworkCliInstall
description: Install the XrmFramework CLI (dotnet tool) and put it on PATH for the rest of the job
author: Dimsi
helpMarkDown: Installs `XrmFramework.Cli` as a .NET tool in a folder of its own and prepends that folder to PATH, so later steps can call `xrmframework` directly. Run this once per job, before the XrmFramework deployment tasks.

inputs.name: Version
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: NuGet version of XrmFramework.Cli to install, for example `3.2.27-beta`. Leave empty for the latest stable release - a prerelease is installed only by naming its version here.

inputs.name: Source
inputs.label: NuGet source
inputs.helpMarkDown: Extra NuGet feed to install from, for a CLI published to a private feed. Leave empty for the sources the agent already knows.

inputs.name: ToolPath
inputs.label: Tool path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder the tool is installed in, prepended to PATH. A folder of its own rather than the agent's global tools folder, which is not reliably on PATH.

outputVariables.name: XrmFrameworkCliPath
outputVariables.description: Full path to the installed xrmframework executable.

outputVariables.name: XrmFrameworkCliVersion
outputVariables.description: Version actually installed, read back from the tool listing.
